en-US: Stream AI note generation on desktop and mobile, and on the web when the model host allows a direct connection; proxied web replies stay complete, and the old streaming setting is gone.
Keep the bulk-move destination from snapping back to the current notebook, so Move actually relocates selected notes.
Paint filled buttons, badges, and progress bars with the brand green instead of a darker emerald.
Keep the diagram editor title bar on the theme surface so dark mode no longer puts light text on a white header.
zh-CN: 桌面端和移动端的 AI 笔记生成改为实时流式输出；网页端在模型服务允许直连时同样流式返回，经实例代理时仍整段给出结果，并去掉原来的流式开关。
批量移动时目标笔记本不再被当前笔记本覆盖，移动操作会真正生效。
实心按钮、徽章和进度条改用品牌绿，不再偏深一档。
图表笔记标题栏改用主题表面色，避免暗色模式下浅色文字落在白底上。
